# GW Plastering & Rendering

> Plastering and rendering firm based in Exeter, covering Devon. Run by George Washbourn,
> a time-served plasterer with 15+ years on the trowel. Specialists in traditional lime
> work on cob and period property, silicone rendering, and internal plastering.

Contact: WhatsApp +44 7557 355420 | gwplasteringdevon@gmail.com
Hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00-18:00
Reviewed independently: Checkatrade (10/10) and Rated People.

## About
- [About George Washbourn](https://gwplastering.co.uk/about): Who runs GW Plastering, training, and specialisms.
